question: Does box exclusion reduce execution cost of a common CIE current-domain refiner while retaining feasible material and original-wave out-of-sample predictions?
objects: Four previously studied structured_pool seeds and eight separately frozen confirmation seeds; all previously exposed to non-CIE fitting research. This CIE comparison is retrospective on those inputs.
fixed_geometry: Exact stored 24x24 TM operator with common 7x7 support, 16 of 32 receivers and 4 of 12 plane waves for fit.
physical_initialization: First existing point of each proposal component for all four arms; auditable full-wave current is projected into the initial inherited Fourier APCS around fixed DPCS. No reference material is accessed.
material_prior: Zero additional penalty; support and inherited per-pixel closed box endpoints enforced in the current-domain material readout.
optimization: Sourcewise nonnegative PR and exact quadratic step, followed by inherited projected material readout. Native point check at initialization, every 16 cycles, and stage boundaries. First in-radius point must pass Arb and stops that branch. Final output is lowest true port residual among checked points.
neumann: Previously used strengthened directional Neumann certificate in box_certificates.py. Unverified decisions are retained.
shifted: Bordered source-threshold certificate used for frozen confirmation. Weights [1/32,1/128] in training receiver spectral units and source index j=1. Binary64 one-sided computation on line, independent Arb checks off line for all exclusions.
point_to_fit: Full-wave evaluation of all 64 proposal points. Rank by best residual in each box; same first proposal point initializes the CIE refiner across arms. First strictly feasible box stops traversal; if all attempts fail select lowest observed residual.
selection: Other arms choose the smallest original-physics training residual among all visited branch outputs; no held-out channels or materials.
reference_evaluation: Verify selected original full-wave endpoint with Arb and score original held-out receivers, held-out sources, inside and background after online predictions are sealed.
timing: Independently execute every arm in per-object order permuted with seed 610419. Include proposal regeneration, screening, CIE, physical audits, and final Arb check. Geometry and Fourier/DPCS setup reusable across arms measured separately; each arm initializes every visited branch separately.
